virality_data.topic: Building an Autonomous In-Browser Web Agent with MCP and Local Execution
virality_data.analysis: AI agents operating locally inside client-side browser contexts via Model Context Protocol (MCP) represent the sharpest transition away from bloated remote agent APIs in 2026. With HKUDS/CLI-Anything gaining 50k+ GitHub stars and Dev.to reporting massive engagement on browser-native agents, developers are desperate for zero-infrastructure agent runtimes. This article provides concrete JavaScript/Python orchestration code to run autonomous workflows without sending DOM states to costly third-party cloud wrappers.
